about_the_game:
The Backrooms Deluxe 2: Founder's Edition is an optional DLC for the free edition of the game for people that want to support me, and gain some benefits. If you've purchased the original game before it became free, you'll also get this for free as a way to appreciate your support. Here are the features included:

9500 DeluxeCoins + 10 x3 Boosts

Start off with 9500 DeluxeCoins and 10 DeluxeCoins boosts that triple your rewards for one run.

Entity Mode

A new (early access) multiplayer-only game mode that can be played in limited-time free weekends, or unlocked permanently by purchasing this DLC. One player is the entity, the others hide. This game mode is still in development and has only one level for now. If you find any issues, you may report them in the Steam Community Hub.
detailed_description:
Online Only

This DLC’s content is available ONLY when online. It can not be accessed in offline mode. Please refer to the main game’s EULA for more information.
